answer.text: The manual does not simply say to restart it; for re-use after storage it is preferable to have the motorcycle prepared at a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre so it is restored to its peak operating condition.
If the battery was disconnected and removed for storage, check that the battery voltage is within specification before refitting it.
If the voltage is not within specification, recharge the battery at an authorized service workshop or battery dealer.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a step-by-step procedure for restarting a bike after storage, and it does not say whether a restart without servicing is safe.
